externalActions.signing: Owner supplies legitimate platform signing and notarisation identities outside the repository.
externalActions.deployment: Owner authorises the production environment, domain and credentials, then an independent verifier observes health and rollback.
externalActions.support_readiness: Owner names on-call and privacy contacts, connects alert delivery, and conducts incident and restore drills.
externalActions.announcement: Owner approves and publishes a version-bound message only after the production-readiness gate passes.
